title: Due Diligence Analyst - Americas
why_fit: Third-party risk, KYC/KYB and documentation review for fintech partners; asks 2-3+ years in risk/compliance, and his Northrop model-audit and internal-controls work is the closest match.
why_us: Alpaca's Risk team vets fintechs and financial institutions before they launch on its brokerage API, and that mix of documentation review and partner follow-up is what I want to do. At Northrop Grumman I audited 100+ financial models for accuracy, compliance and internal controls, so I am used to spotting gaps and inconsistencies. At AMG Family Dental I chase down missing documentation and follow up until items close. I also like that the role is partner-facing, because I enjoy explaining requirements clearly.
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Due Diligence Analyst - Americas role on Alpaca's Risk team. The work you describe, reviewing partner documentation for completeness and risk indicators, tracking onboarding items to launch deadlines and explaining requirements to partners, lines up with the way I have worked for the past three years.

As a Financial Intern at Northrop Grumman in 2022, I audited more than 100 financial models for accuracy, compliance and internal controls. That meant reading documentation closely, finding inconsistencies and reporting them clearly. I also analyzed supplier costs and budget variances across programs and presented cost-saving recommendations to senior leadership, so I am comfortable communicating findings to people who need a direct answer.

Since August 2023 I have been the Financial Manager at AMG Family Dental in Belmont, MA, where I direct financial operations for a practice serving 1,000+ patients a year. I improved our financial reporting and reconciliation process in Dentrix and recovered more than $500K in annual revenue by following up on underpaid claims. I also automated our weekly insurance payment reconciliation with Python, cutting processing time from 5 hours to 1 and flagging underpaid claims for follow-up. That is tracking outstanding items until they are resolved, which is the core of onboarding diligence.

My M.A. in International Economics & Finance from Brandeis and my B.S. in Finance from Suffolk give me the grounding to read regulatory and financial material, and I am fluent in English and Armenian, which helps with an international partner base. I will be direct that most of my experience is in finance operations and controls rather than in AML or KYC programs. I learn quickly and would bring the same organization and persistence to your partner onboarding process.

Thank you for your consideration. I am available immediately and would welcome a conversation.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian

title: Portfolio Analyst, Sponsor & Specialty Finance
why_fit: Loan portfolio monitoring, delinquency tracking and reporting match his A/R aging and reconciliation work, but the posting requires 3+ years of portfolio management experience (gap).
why_us: This role tracks loan delinquencies, collects borrower financial statements and works with Finance so loans are accounted for correctly. I do a similar job at AMG Family Dental, where I cut A/R aging by 10% by improving claim follow-up and reconciled payments to catch underpaid claims worth $500K+ a year. I want to apply that collections and reconciliation discipline to a commercial lending portfolio in Boston, and Santander's sponsor and specialty finance group is a place to learn underwriting from the portfolio side.
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Portfolio Analyst, Sponsor & Specialty Finance position in Boston. The role asks for someone who tracks delinquencies, collects borrower financial reporting, works with Finance on loan accounting and keeps portfolio data accurate. I have done close cousins of each of those tasks, and I want to bring them into lending.

At AMG Family Dental in Belmont, MA, I have been Financial Manager since August 2023. I oversee billing, collections and revenue tracking for a practice serving 1,000+ patients a year. I reduced A/R aging by 10% by streamlining claim submission and follow-up, and I recovered more than $500K in annual revenue by improving reporting and reconciliation in Dentrix. I also automated our weekly insurance payment reconciliation with Python, cutting the work from 5 hours to 1 and flagging underpaid claims for follow-up. Tracking what is owed, why it is late and who needs a call is the daily rhythm of that job.

I also build the annual operating budget and monthly forecasts and report budget-versus-actual variances and KPIs to ownership, so I am used to turning raw numbers into a clear recommendation. At Northrop Grumman I audited 100+ financial models for accuracy and internal controls and presented cost-saving findings to senior leadership.

My M.A. in International Economics & Finance (STEM) from Brandeis covered Corporate Finance, Econometrics and Advanced Finance, and I use Excel, SQL and Python regularly. I should be upfront that the posting asks for 3+ years in portfolio or asset management, and my experience is in finance operations, reconciliation and reporting rather than loan portfolio management. I am a fast learner and would take on underwriting concepts and the loan system quickly.

Thank you for your time. I am a US citizen, available immediately, and would be glad to talk.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian
